#ifndef BASE_HPP
#define BASE_HPP
struct Point { double x, y; };
class Named {
public:
    virtual const char* name() const { return "named"; }
};
template <class K, class V> struct Pair { K first; V second; };
#if __cplusplus >= 202002L
template <typename T>
concept Number = requires(T t) { t + t; };
template <Number T> T twice(T v) { return v + v; }
#endif
#endif
